crossRefs.note: Jesus answered, “Weren’t the ten cleansed? But where are the nine?
Were there none found who returned to give glory to God, except this foreigner?”
In those days Hezekiah was terminally ill, and he prayed to Yahweh; and he spoke to him, and gave him a sign.
I will extol you, Yahweh, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.
Yahweh my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.
You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,
to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. Yahweh my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.
What will I give to Yahweh for all his benefits toward me?
Yah has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.
Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to Yah.
The living, the living, he shall praise you, as I do today. The father shall make known your truth to the children.
Afterward Jesus found him in the temple, and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing…
He said, “Lord, I believe!” and he worshiped him.

translations.web: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.
translations.bsb: When one of them saw that he was healed, he came back, praising God in a loud voice.
translations.kjv: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God,
